name: Malory Towers
description: Follow the adventures of Darrell Rivers as she leaves home for the first time to attend an all-girls’ boarding school. Set in post-war Britain on the sun-drenched cliffs of the Cornish coast, the series explores a nostalgic world of midnight feasts, lacrosse, pranks, a mystery ghost and lasting friendships.

videos.title: The Ghost of Christmas Present
videos.overview: When Darrell finds herself stranded at an empty Malory Towers for Christmas, she has to hold her nerve when strange things start happening around the school.

videos.title: The Ghost of Christmas Past
videos.overview: With the strange goings-on still happening, the girls are determined to find help. However, when Gwen disappears on Christmas morning, their efforts turn to finding their friend.

videos.title: The First Day
videos.overview: In awe of Malory Towers, Darrell keeps her past at her old school a close secret. Always in the thick of it, Darrell has a hairy start at the train station and when odd sounds are heard in the dorm, learns about the ghost of Lady Jane Malory.

videos.title: The New Girls
videos.overview: When Gwen leaves the school to learn about Darrell’s past, Darrell must try to stop her before it's too late. Meanwhile, not knowing where their dormmates are, the North Tower girls do all they can to cover when the Matron comes for lights out.

videos.title: The Trick
videos.overview: In an attempt to impress Alicia, Darrell unleashes a prank in Mam'zelle's class. Trick sweets sent by Alicia's brothers cause havoc in the school, and strange happenings continue when a mysterious red handprint appears in the dorm.

videos.title: The Slap
videos.overview: On a scorching hot day at Malory Towers, Miss Potts lets the First Form girls go down to the pool. Jealous of Darrell and Alicia's new friendship, Gwen takes the fun and games too far.

videos.title: The Match
videos.overview: Darrell is up to play in the lacrosse game, but her excitement is short lived when she finds out they'll be playing against her old school. Darrell must face her past and overcome her temper if she wants to win the match.

videos.title: The Midnight Feast
videos.overview: Alicia's family sends a bounty of food, and the girls are all set to have their first North Tower midnight feast. But when Matron wakes during the feast, all Darrell’s worst fears are realized. Will the girls escape?

videos.title: The Open Day
videos.overview: On open day, Malory Towers bursts with energy and visiting families. But Darrell's joy is short-lived when she finds out her half-term results. She is determined to keep them a secret from her parents.

videos.title: The Push
videos.overview: After a confrontation with Darrell about her family, Sally is found hiding in pain. However, her injuries are far more serious than first thought. Fearing she is at fault, Darrell leaves the school to find a doctor.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: Darrell is itching to get to the bottom of Sally's relationship with her family, but when Sally goes missing, the First Form rallies together to comb the grounds. Darrell and Sally finally discover the real reason Sally was sent to Malory Towers.

videos.title: The Dress
videos.overview: A beautiful dress arrives at Malory Towers: one of the girls is a debutante, destined to marry into aristocracy. When Darrell finds out who the mystery girl is, she's determined to prove the girl is a poor choice.

videos.title: The Spider
videos.overview: Feeling guilty for lashing out at Mary-Lou, Darrell and Sally hatch a plan to give Mary-Lou the confidence she needs. But will the plan backfire and make Mary-Lou less courageous?

videos.title: The Ghost
videos.overview: In the dead of night Mary-Lou faints when she sees a hooded figure in the dorm bathroom. Not wanting Mary-Lou's courage to be crushed, Darrell and Sally are determined to get to the bottom of the mystery.

videos.title: The Last Day
videos.overview: May-Lou is devastated to find her courage pen smashed on the floor. When Darrell's shoes are found with ink on them, Darrell is the prime suspect, and the North Tower holds a class court.

videos.title: The Head of Form
videos.overview: Darrell and her class return to Malory Towers. The first order of business: elect a new class leader. Gwen decides to take the new girl under her wing and become her best friend.

videos.title: The Dunce's Cap
videos.overview: Alicia convinces Darrell to help her play a prank on their teachers with invisible chalk. Meanwhile, Mr Parker becomes stricter with his teaching. Mary-Lou finds her voice and stands up for herself.

videos.title: The Stray
videos.overview: The girls attempt to make Ellen feel more included but their efforts backfire. Miss Grayling has a secret that might put Malory Towers in danger.

videos.title: The Auditions
videos.overview: In an attempt to impress her parents, Gwen auditions for the lead role in the upcoming school play. Darrell and Sally devise a plan to save the school.

videos.title: The Caricatures
videos.overview: When Alicia’s birthday gift from her parents doesn’t arrive, she takes it out on her teachers. Gwen becomes more tangled in her lies.

videos.title: The Runaway
videos.overview: Ellen is stressed that she’ll lose her scholarship and stays up all night studying for an exam. Gwen gets her hands on Darrell’s diary and discovers Darrell's secret.

videos.title: The Play
videos.overview: Darrell shows a potential investor around Malory Towers. Gwen is confronted with her lies when her mother visits.

videos.title: The Measles
videos.overview: A teacher and Gwen are quarantined after finding out they have the measles. Darrell finds out disturbing news about the future of Malory Towers. Sally takes on extra responsibilities.

videos.title: The Sneezing Trick
videos.overview: Alicia and Darrell pull a sneezing prank on their French teacher, which disappoints Sally. Someone has stolen important possessions from the girls.

videos.title: The School Trip
videos.overview: Gwen resorts to drastic measures to hide what she’s stolen. Darrell and Sally find a clue that could finally lead them to Lady Jane Malory’s treasure.

videos.title: The Quiz
videos.overview: Malory Towers competes with the local boys' school in a competition. Ellen suffers a panic attack when she is accused of Gwen's misdeeds.

videos.title: The Heroine
videos.overview: The girls doubt Ellen’s innocence. Gwen attempts to get rid of the items she stole, endangering Mary-Lou in the process.

videos.title: The Lost Treasure
videos.overview: Miss Grayling reveals disheartening news. In one last attempt to save the school, Darrell and Sally try to find Lady Jane’s lost treasure. Gwen’s secrets come to light.

videos.title: New Arrivals
videos.overview: The girls welcome Bill and her horse, Thunder, to Malory Towers, but Bill’s place in the Third Form is under threat when she is accused of spending too much time in the stables. Gwen’s father is offered the position of head of board at the school.

videos.title: The Trials
videos.overview: Darrell scouts out players for the lacrosse team, and discovers that Gwen has some hidden talents. Mary-Lou discovers a skin condition that worries her. Matron must fill in for the biology teacher.

videos.title: The Surprise Picnic
videos.overview: Darrell suggests a midnight feast in the stables, but they’re afraid of horse poachers. Mavis, a Sixth Former, is on the hunt for someone to accompany her on the piano for an important audition, and Irene might fit the bill.

videos.title: The Accident
videos.overview: Bill struggles to balance her schoolwork with time spent at the stables with her horse, Thunder. Bill and Darrell need Thunder's help when someone at the school has a serious accident.

videos.title: The New Headmistress
videos.overview: Miss Johnson enforces a list of tough new rules which get the better Darrell’s temper. An important lacrosse match is at stake when Darrell is given a particularly difficult punishment.

videos.title: The Voice
videos.overview: Sally returns to a very different Malory Towers after her case of the mumps. The strict new rules keep Mavis and Irene from their audition, but the girls have a plan to cover for them and keep Miss Johnson at bay.

videos.title: The Dance
videos.overview: Gwen goes a little overboard when she organizes a dance lesson with the Thackerton boys. Mary-Lou discovers a mysterious statue in the woods when Gwen asks her to break the rules to gather ivy.

videos.title: The Sisters
videos.overview: Darrell’s sister Felicity visits to take an exam that will determine her acceptance at Malory Towers. Darrell wants to enjoy time with her sister but Miss Johnson's strict rules stand in the way.

videos.title: The Hamper
videos.overview: Alicia sends a package for the girls filled with goodies and prank materials, plus a secret message. Darrell prepares for the lacrosse trial and sneaks in practice time.

videos.title: The Peaches
videos.overview: With the Third Form on a trip to the circus, Darrell and Sally attempt to recover the confiscated peaches from Miss Johnson’s office, but they find more than they expected.

videos.title: The Ride
videos.overview: Bill will stop at nothing when she discovers that her horse Thunder is sick with colic. Gwen is charged with keeping Bill away from the stables or else they will both be punished.

videos.title: The Arrest
videos.overview: Ron shows Darrell and Sally a stash of art found in the stables, but where did it come from? Miss Johnson is caught off-guard when Miss Grayling arrives back at Malory Towers.

videos.title: The Thief
videos.overview: With Darrell focused on clearing Ron’s name, Mary-Lou and Ellen uncover new information that changes everything they thought about the art thefts.

videos.title: The Rivers Sisters
videos.overview: After being selected as head of lower school, Darrell soon feels the demands of leadership when Felicity, her younger sister just starting at Malory Towers, gets into trouble.

videos.title: The Doubloon
videos.overview: Darrell enlists the help of the First Form students when facing her first challenge to her authority as head of lower school.

videos.title: The Inter-Tower Match
videos.overview: Preparing for the inter-tower lacrosse match leads to disappointment for Darrell and Felicity. The rest of the team speculates why breakout star Clarissa is hesitant to play.

videos.title: The Essay
videos.overview: Ruth lets her sister Connie take credit for her essay. The First Formers try to evade Darrell while searching for treasure.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: The First Formers try to prank their teachers with Irene's help. Mademoiselle's reaction to the prank raises suspicions for Irene.

videos.title: The Midnight Surprise
videos.overview: Alicia plans an outdoor midnight feast for her and Darrell. Felicity and June sneak out to search for a hidden room within Malory Towers.

videos.title: The Speech
videos.overview: Darrell struggles to prepare a speech she is to give in front of the whole school. Sally and Bill organize a lacrosse match. Irene’s father delivers news Irene has not been looking forward to.

videos.title: The Connie Affair
videos.overview: June makes some itching powder for a prank that gets out of hand. Connie blames June for the unfortunate things that keep happening to her, even though June insists she had nothing to do with them.

videos.title: The Strong Heart
videos.overview: When Clarissa receives troubling news that her pony has been sold, she breaks the rules to rescue him. Irene and Mademoiselle Rougier make efforts to strengthen their relationship.

videos.title: The Field Trip
videos.overview: Felicity and June prove to be a handful when Darrell supervises the class field trip. Meanwhile, Gwen gets more than she bargained for when left with Mr Parker's pregnant wife.

videos.title: The Exam
videos.overview: Darrell and her classmates await their exams while Felicity and June continue to explore the secret room. Gwen pretends to have heart issues to get out of the exam but then finds herself in a dangerous situation.

videos.title: The Terrible Day
videos.overview: Ruth’s bullying of Connie reaches a new low when June is wrongly accused of playing pranks. Darrell encourages the lower form to find who is responsible and the whole class gets a lesson on accountability.

videos.title: The Wedding Day
videos.overview: June and Darrell find themselves in danger when they leave the school to continue the search for the treasure in a cave during high tide. The rest of the school prepares for the wedding. Irene is given an important task by her father.

videos.title: The Rivers Sisters Return
videos.overview: Felicity struggles to get out of Darrell's shadow in her second year at Malory Towers. Newcomer Jo struggles to follow the rules, getting Felicity caught in the crosshairs. Mary Lou debates how strict to be after becoming head of lower school.

videos.title: The Monitor Strike
videos.overview: June leads the Second Form girls in a strike to protect Clarissa from Gwen's constant demands, resulting in a big change. When a pipe bursts, old memories resurface and a new friend is made. Archaeological research begins at Malory Towers.

videos.title: The Circus
videos.overview: Felicity and Jo meet a young acrobat girl and Jo promises to take Felicity to the circus. When Jo breaks the rules to fulfill her promise, Miss Grayling teaches her a lesson about friendship. Twins Ruth and Connie start to notice their differences.

videos.title: The Beautiful Game
videos.overview: Clarissa goes undercover to prove that girls can play soccer just as good as boys. Darrell and Susan help Mr Murray look for ancient symbols in the garden as they continue their archaeology research.

videos.title: The Pocket Money
videos.overview: Jo and Connie trick Felicity into helping them retrieve Jo's confiscated pocket money from Matron's safe. The Second Form girls protest Jo's rule-breaking.

videos.title: The Fugitives
videos.overview: Afraid of being accused of stealing, Jo and Connie run away to the village. Darrell helps a worried Ruth search for her sister. When the girls return to Malory Towers, Jo's father learns about her misdeeds.

videos.title: The Babysitter
videos.overview: Gwen has plans with Ron, but gets stuck watching Mr Parker's baby. Alicia recruits Felicity to the cross-country team, much to Darrell's dismay. When baby Kathleen goes missing, Gwen attempts to pass off the blame.

videos.title: The Malory Oak
videos.overview: June pulls a daring stunt to save the beloved Malory Oak from being chopped down by Mr Murray. The Second Form girls learn about chores and hard work. Jo trusts Felicity and Connie with a secret about her mother.

videos.title: The Unexpected Visitor
videos.overview: Mrs Heather appears suddenly to take Susan home. The Second Form girls start a prank war with Mam'zelle. Ruth and Clarissa find a way for Susan to stay at Malory Towers.

videos.title: The Race
videos.overview: On the day of the big race, Felicity cracks under the pressure of Alicia's tough coaching. Matron goes on vacation to see her family. The new nurse, Nurse Jane, has her hands full right away when Darrell gets injured looking for Felicity.

videos.title: The New Matron
videos.overview: Nurse Jane gets off to a bumpy start with Mam’zelle when the Second Form receive a box of tricks. Darrell's eagerness to play sports again lands her back in the San.

videos.title: The Maypole
videos.overview: It's the day of the summer fair, and when Jo is made queen, she has a tricky decision to make. Darrell is still stuck in the San and grows suspicious of Nurse Jane.

videos.title: The Investigation
videos.overview: Matron Shipley is horrified to learn that there is an imposter in the San. It’s not long before Darrell and Sally uncover the truth about the mysterious Nurse Jane.

videos.title: The Penalty
videos.overview: The pressure is on for the Second Form to win a local football tournament and buy George the Donkey his freedom, before the abattoir takes him away.

videos.title: The Dream
videos.overview: While directing the school play, Gwen spots performing talent in Felicity - but it isn’t long before Felicity is torn between her acting commitments and helping her sister.

videos.title: The Birthday Surprise
videos.overview: Ruth and Connie think they have received a camera for their birthday, but when the Second Formers take a comic photo of Matron, they have to work to retrieve the film.

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: Darrell and Alicia’s friendship is put to the test when Alicia adds obstacles to the school race. Meanwhile, Ruth and Susan go in search of answers about Mr Murray’s findings.

videos.title: The Poison Pen
videos.overview: The school play is looming, and director Gwen isn’t happy with rehearsals. When she lashes out at the cast, Jo takes matters into her own hands. Can she make Gwen see sense?

videos.title: The Last Letter
videos.overview: Jo’s letters spiral out of control when Felicity is wrongly accused. Gwen isn’t going to let the perpetrator get off lightly. Can Jo do the right thing?

videos.title: The Chamber
videos.overview: The pressure is on for Gwen when Felicity suddenly gets stage fright. Meanwhile, Ruth and Susan’s hard work comes to fruition when they make an amazing discovery.

videos.title: The First Day of the Last Year
videos.overview: Darrell’s final year starts with a fierce argument with Gwen, but she knows they need to work together. French student Celeste joins the Third and plays a prank on the teachers.

videos.title: The Malory Times
videos.overview: Alicia falls out with Darrell and the other Sixth Formers when she edits the school newsletter. Jo and Susan get into trouble with Mr Parker over his new typewriter.

videos.title: Le Petit Paris
videos.overview: The girls try to cheer up Celeste, who wants to get expelled so she can go home to see her mother. Mary-Lou finds herself facing a snail invasion when she takes an art class.

videos.title: The Band
videos.overview: Irene offers to help Ron with his band, who are playing that afternoon, forgetting she has to take an important music exam. Felicity and June find clues to the missing time capsule.

videos.title: The Birthday
videos.overview: Angry about not receiving a present from Paris, Celeste hides in the stables. However, she is trapped there with Matron when the stables catch fire.

videos.title: The Nurse
videos.overview: Celeste lies that she started the fire on purpose to be sent home. Sally confronts Matron about her eyesight, and Miss Grayling finally tells Celeste the truth about her mother.

videos.title: The Debate
videos.overview: When Felicity and Darrell debate whether the Third should have the same freedoms as the Sixth, the sisters end up in a personal argument. Gwen’s attempt at matronly duties ends in chaos.

videos.title: The Ward
videos.overview: Matron arrives with Nancy, her young ward. Gwen tells her to ask Matron to stay, which annoys Matron. Nancy joins the Third Formers as they search for the missing time capsule.

videos.title: The Best Friend
videos.overview: Jo causes chaos when she tells Celeste's mother that Celeste doesn't want to return home. Nancy, June and Felicity are excited to discover that Fred knows about the time capsule.

videos.title: The Photo
videos.overview: Alicia and Darrell are trapped in the cellar after Alicia receives some bad news. Can finding the time capsule help them? Irene feels pressured by her musical ambitions.

videos.title: The Spelling Bee
videos.overview: Gwen is shocked into drastic action when her father refuses to sign her application to finishing school. Darrell and Felicity fall out during the North Tower Spelling Bee.

videos.title: The Champions
videos.overview: Clarissa challenges her brother's team, Thackerton Boys, to a lacrosse match after he insults her playing skills. Mr Parker worries about Nancy when she is put in goal.

videos.title: The Movie Star
videos.overview: Gwen plots for movie star and Miss Grayling’s estranged cousin Lily Vernon to visit the school. Lily has her own secrets. Nancy plans a prank to stop eating carrots.

videos.title: The Riding Mistress
videos.overview: Bill is shocked when Thunder is put up for sale, and she desperately tries to keep him. The Third Formers prank Miss Vernon so they can get out of class to go for a swim.

videos.title: The Scoop
videos.overview: Jean reveals uncomfortable truths about the Grayling family which shock Lily. Darrell and Alicia plan the best prank ever, involving ancient curses and a skeleton.

videos.title: The Shoot
videos.overview: Lily discovers a hidden secret when she and Jo make a film. Miss Grayling is angry with Lily, who decides to leave - but has she gone for good?

videos.title: The Intruder
videos.overview: Felicity and June follow a mysterious girl in uniform to Miss Grayling’s study, but she runs off. Miss Grayling checks her room, which appears in order - what did the intruder want?

videos.title: The Abandoned Cottage
videos.overview: Jo discovers Lily Vernon hiding out in the abandoned cottage and agrees to help her in secret, while Alicia decides Darrell needs to relax and plans their final midnight feast.

videos.title: The Traitor
videos.overview: Gwen is furious with her father when he puts her future plans in doubt, but she is shocked when she finds out the truth. Jo believes Malory Towers now belongs to Lily.

videos.title: The Last Day of Malory Towers
videos.overview: Darrell is shocked to discover Lily’s plans and needs to act before Malory Towers is lost forever, while Gwen finds out Ron is joining the army and has to consider her own future.
